subject.title: refactor(qa): migrate Matrix scenarios into QA Lab

question: After the two code blockers are repaired on a new head, should the intentional relocation of `@openclaw/matrix` into QA Lab be authorized for that exact head?
rationale: Repository policy deliberately blocks dependency graph changes until an authorized admin or security owner confirms the new dependency ownership and resolved graph.

options.title: Authorize after repairs
options.body: Approve the dependency relocation only after the findings are fixed and the exact new head shows the expected manifest and lockfile delta.

options.title: Keep dependency ownership unchanged
options.body: Require the stack to avoid moving the Matrix dependency into QA Lab and redesign the migration boundary.

recommendation.title: Authorize after repairs
recommendation.body: Approve the dependency relocation only after the findings are fixed and the exact new head shows the expected manifest and lockfile delta.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent package-boundary and QA history plus the dependency-guard approver list make this the strongest available routing candidate.
